tasks.label: C++: build & run current file
tasks.command: if (!(Test-Path build)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build | Out-Null }; g++ -std=c++14 -Wall -Wextra -g -Icpp/include "${relativeFile}" -o "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"; if ($?) { & "build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" }
tasks.detail: Compile the open .cpp with MinGW g++ into build/ and run it

tasks.label: Java: build & run current file
tasks.command: $src = "${relativeFile}"; $rel = $src -replace '^java[\\/]src[\\/]',''; $fqn = ($rel -replace '\.java$','') -replace '[\\/]','.'; if (!(Test-Path build/java)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build/java | Out-Null }; javac -d build/java -sourcepath java/src "$src"; if ($?) { java -cp build/java $fqn }
tasks.detail: Compile the open .java into build/java and run its main class
